articles.title: Patrick Mahomes faces new Chiefs concern as Kenneth Walker’s status for Bills game remains uncertain
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City Chiefs could face a major setback ahead of their Thanksgiving showdown against the Buffalo Bills.
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs could face a major setback ahead of their Thanksgiving showdown against the Buffalo Bills.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs have handled running back Kenneth Walker III ’s return with extreme caution, gradually working him back into action after his injury.

However, a potential absence for Walker in this week’s crucial matchup against the Buffalo Bills could raise serious red flags inside the organization and become a bigger concern for Kansas City as the season winds down, according to one analyst.

Kenneth Walker could become a larger problem for the Chiefs

Joshua Brisco of SI.com responded to a fan’s question about the Chiefs’ plan if Walker is unable to play Thursday night against Buffalo. While the running back appears close to returning, the analyst warned that any new setback could carry significant consequences.

“To fully wade into a hypothetical that might be irrelevant by the time Tuesday’s injury report comes out: If Walker doesn’t play in Buffalo, I think you have to have some level of concern about his timeline and expectations for the rest of the year, simply due to the possibility that a short-term injury, downplayed by the team, could be lingering much longer than the player and team expected,” Brisco wrote.

“That’s always alarming until the player returns and looks like their pre-injury self.”

Kansas City received positive news on Tuesday when Kenneth Walker III returned to practice , though his participation against the Bills is still not guaranteed.

Head coach Andy Reid explained that the running back would not receive a heavy workload during his return to the practice field.

“We’ll see how he does. I’m not anticipating a ton of work there but he’ll get out there and move around,” Reid said.

The Chiefs may adjust their offensive approach

Walker’s situation could force the Chiefs to place greater emphasis on the run game against Buffalo, particularly given the weather expected for the Thanksgiving matchup.

The forecast calls for cold temperatures and strong winds, with the possibility of a winter storm producing gusts of up to 50 miles per hour—a factor that could limit the passing attacks of both teams.

In that scenario, Kansas City could increase the workload of rookie running back Emmett Johnson , who has performed well in Walker’s absence.

With Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs fighting to stay near the top of the AFC standings , Walker’s progress will be one of the most closely watched storylines ahead of the Buffalo game.

articles.title: Brittany and Patrick Mahomes' kids have their royal moment at the Kansas City Current parade
articles.standfirst: The team's celebration featured some adorable moments that stole the spotlight beyond the soccer field.
articles.summary: The team's celebration featured some adorable moments that stole the spotlight beyond the soccer field.
articles.body:
B rittany Mahomes had plenty of reasons to join the festivities on Tuesday, November 24 . The Kansas City Current co-owner celebrated the franchise's first NWSL championship, secured with a 2-1 victory over the Washington Spirit in Saturday's final, November 21, at Audi Field in Washington, D.C.

And while the championship was the main attraction of the day, two special guests also caught everyone's attention during the parade through the streets of Kansas City: her children, Sterling and Bronze.

Brittany and Patrick Mahomes' kids get their royal moment

The little ones rode alongside their mom on one of the parade vehicles . Wearing Current jerseys, caps and sweatshirts, they waved to the fans gathered along the streets, looking up at them as the children enjoyed the celebration from above, like true members of royalty.

Brittany shared some of these moments on her Instagram Stories, but one scene featuring Sterling stood out from the rest. The little girl was fascinated as a shower of colorful confetti burst into the air and filled the sky. Her look of amazement was one of the sweetest moments of the day.

Randi Mahomes also joins the celebration

The family was also represented by Randi Mahomes, Patrick's mother, who joined Brittany for the parade .

The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback couldn't attend because of his NFL commitments, but his absence didn't stop Brittany from sharing the celebration with other members of the family.

articles.title: Randi Mahomes opens up about her pride in Brittany and the example she sets for her granddaughters
articles.standfirst: After the KC Current won its first NWSL title, Patrick Mahomes’ mother celebrated her daughter-in-law’s hard work
articles.summary: After the KC Current won its first NWSL title, Patrick Mahomes’ mother celebrated her daughter-in-law’s hard work
articles.body:
R andi Mahomes had more than congratulations to share after the Kansas City Current won its first NWSL championship . In a heartfelt message, she said she was proud of Brittany and “all the hard work and love she has put into the KC Current from the very beginning.”

Celebrating the team’s title with her family made the moment even more special, Randi wrote. She loves watching Brittany’s dreams come true and knows that when her daughter-in-law is happy, her son Patrick Mahomes and her grandchildren are happy, too.

A championship years in the making

Brittany Mahomes helped launch the KC Current in 2020 and is a co-owner of the club. The team’s first league title came on Nov. 21, when it beat the Washington Spirit, 2-1. For Randi, the win carried a personal meaning: she had watched Brittany invest years of work and care in the team, then got to celebrate the result alongside her family.

Patrick Mahomes’ mother joined her daughter-in-law and the rest of the family in Kansas City to celebrate the championship. In her message, Randi praised Brittany’s dedication to the Current and the example she sets for her daughters.

The title was a milestone for Brittany as a co-owner and a proud moment for Randi, who had watched her work toward this dream.

Patrick Mahomes couldn’t attend the championship game because the Chiefs played the next day. He celebrated the KC Current’s win online and wore the team’s shirt to the Chiefs game. Afterward, he said it was “really cool” to see the players’ hard work pay off.

Randi’s message showed how much she wants her daughter-in-law to be happy and supported. She has watched Brittany work toward this dream for years, so seeing her celebrate the championship with her daughters meant a lot. As their grandmother, Randi was proud to share the moment with them.

articles.title: Jackson Mahomes doesn't miss the Kansas City Current parade with Brittany while making it clear that he is already a ‘good boy’
articles.standfirst: Patrick Mahomes' brother shared images from the celebration of Kansas City's team winning its first NWSL title. Since his 2024 conviction for misdemeanor assault, his public activity has been much more closely tied to his family and the Chiefs' circle.
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes' brother shared images from the celebration of Kansas City's team winning its first NWSL title. Since his 2024 conviction for misdemeanor assault, his public activity has been much more closely tied to his family and the Chiefs' circle.
articles.body:
Jackson Mahomes was present at the Kansas City Current celebration parade, which on Tuesday, November 24 celebrated its first National Women"s Soccer League (NWSL) championship. Patrick Mahomes' brother was joined by Brittany, his nieces Sterling and Bronze, and Randi Mahomes during the festivities, a day he also shared through his Instagram stories.

Jackson's presence drew attention due to his lower media exposure in recent times. After the legal case he was involved in in 2023 and the resolution of that process in 2024, the influencer has kept a lower profile, with a large part of his posts related to his brother, the Kansas City Chiefs, and his family circle.

Jackson Mahomes, with a lower profile after the legal case

The episode that changed his relationship with the press occurred in February 2023, when he was accused of sexually assaulting a woman at a restaurant in Overland Park, Kansas. He initially faced three counts of aggravated sexual assault , which were dismissed in January 2024 after the complainant stopped cooperating with the prosecution. However, he still had a pending charge of misdemeanor assault.

In March of that same year, Jackson pleaded no contest —a legal formula by which he accepts the conviction without admitting guilt—to that final charge. A judge sentenced him to six months of probation.

Since then, his presence in the news has been considerably lower, and his public appearances have been mainly related to family and sporting events. This time he did so alongside Brittany and Randi at a historic celebration for the Kansas City Current, which captured its first NWSL title after defeating the Washington Spirit 2-1 in the final played on November 21.

What happened to his relationship with Shyanne Blankenship?

Another aspect that has been pushed into the background is his love life. In April 2025, Jackson posted a video with Shyanne Blankenship on TikTok with the message "Hard launch," an expression used on social media to publicly introduce a relationship. In the images, he appeared hugging her and giving her a kiss on the cheek.

During the following months, he also shared photos and videos with her. One of the latest known posts came in September 2025, when he accompanied an image in which he appeared kissing her with the message "Happy w/ u". However, there has been no recent public confirmation about the continuation of the relationship.

For now, Jackson continues to show up at important moments for the Mahomes.

articles.title: Josh Allen won't ruin Patrick Mahomes' plans for his son Bronze after the game against the Bills: "We have a party planned"
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback already has his sights set on celebrating his son’s fourth birthday back home this weekend
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback already has his sights set on celebrating his son’s fourth birthday back home this weekend
articles.body:
When Patrick Mahomes takes the field at Highmark Stadium on Thursday, November 26, for an 8:20 p.m. ET Thanksgiving night showdown against Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills , the stakes in the AFC could hardly be higher.

Entering Week 12 at 8-2, tied atop the AFC West with the Denver Broncos and chasing a fourth consecutive victory, Kansas City faces a 9-1 Buffalo squad in the 11th career meeting between two of the league’s premier quarterbacks.

While the all-time series stands dead even at 5-5, the Bills hold a commanding 5-1 advantage in regular-season matchups, meaning top conference seeding is squarely on the line in Orchard Park.

Mahomes made clear during his pregame media availability that he expects another physical, down-to-the-wire battle against Allen .

“You know it's going to take your best football,” he told reporters this week. “It's always exciting, it's always fun.” Yet once the final whistle blows in western New York, the three-time Super Bowl MVP has an equally important assignment waiting for him: celebrating his son Patrick “Bronze” Mahomes III , who turns four on Saturday, November 28.

Asked how he is juggling short-week holiday prep with party planning, Mahomes smiled and confirmed that family festivities are already locked in regardless of Thursday’s scoreboard.

“We have a party planned,” he said. “We can't disclose exactly where, but the family will be in town, and there will be a party.”

If recent history is any indication, the celebration won’t be low-key, for Bronze’s second birthday, Patrick and his wife, Brittany , threw a golf-themed bash complete with a sign reading “Teeing up for Two!”, and followed it up with an elaborate Spider-Man party for year three.

Brittany Mahomes’ fourth pregnancy revives a viral Chiefs Super Bowl theory

Bronze’s upcoming birthday arrives amid another major milestone for the Mahomes household. Earlier this month, Patrick and Brittany announced they are expecting their fourth child, later revealing they are adding another boy to join five-year-old Sterling , Bronze , and 22-month-old Golden.

That news immediately sent Chiefs Kingdom into overdrive over a remarkably consistent championship coincidence.

Fans quickly pointed out that every previous pregnancy or birth in the Mahomes family has coincided with a Kansas City trip to the Super Bowl.

Brittany was pregnant with Sterling during the 2020 season when the Chiefs reached Super Bowl LV against Tampa Bay; Bronze arrived in November 2022 shortly before Kansas City defeated Philadelphia in Super Bowl LVII; and Golden was born during the January 2025 playoff bye week ahead of another Super Bowl appearance against the Eagles.

Put on the spot about whether baby number four, and another boy to team up with Bronze, could power another Lombardi Trophy run, Mahomes leaned right into the superstition. “I'm hoping!” he said.

“I don't know if Brittany is, but I'm hoping that we can keep that going and get another Super Bowl win with a baby on the way. That'd be awesome for sure.” Brittany chimed in on her Instagram Stories with matching humor, writing, “Glad someone finally figured this out, just doing my part over here,” alongside a string of laughing emojis. First comes Thursday night in Buffalo, and right after that, birthday cake.

articles.title: Andy Reid reacts when the final detail of his famous secret seven-cheese macaroni recipe is revealed
articles.standfirst: Chiefs coach has hilarious response after Velveeta is identified as secret seventh cheese
articles.summary: Chiefs coach has hilarious response after Velveeta is identified as secret seventh cheese
articles.body:
Kansas City Chiefs head coach Andy Reid has finally seen his long-running mac and cheese mystery solved, but he isn't quite ready to reveal everything himself.

After years of speculation surrounding his famous seven-cheese recipe, journalist Pablo Torre uncovered the missing ingredient, prompting a humorous response from Reid during his Tuesday press conference.

The mystery dates back to March 2018, when Reid shared details of his Thanksgiving favorite with The Athletic's Charles McDonald during an airport encounter.

The coach revealed that his recipe contained seven types of cheese, although only six were initially identified. Fontina, mozzarella, Parmesan, sharp cheddar, Gouda and Gruyère were among the ingredients, leaving one important piece of the puzzle missing.

Torre eventually took up the challenge on his show, Pablo Torre Finds Out, turning the search into an investigation that involved several people connected to the Chiefs. His determination to uncover the final ingredient eventually paid off.

Former Kansas City offensive tackle Mitchell Schwartz provided the breakthrough. After obtaining the recipe and speaking with Torre , Schwartz identified the missing ingredient as Velveeta, which Reid apparently uses to add richness and help create a smooth cheese sauce.

The discovery became the centerpiece of a Thanksgiving-themed episode, with Torre reuniting with McDonald before bringing celebrity chef David Chang into the story. Chang prepared the dish alongside ESPN analyst Mina Kimes , giving the group an opportunity to taste the long-discussed mac and cheese.

The recipe also features a crunchy topping made with cornflakes and melted butter, a finishing touch that adds another layer to Reid's comfort-food favorite. Schwartz also shared Reid's cooking instructions, which ended with the coach's enthusiastic message: “DIG IN BABY!!!”

Reid jokes about keeping the final ingredient under wraps

The investigation eventually reached Reid himself when a reporter asked whether Velveeta was indeed the seventh cheese. The Chiefs coach offered a joking response rather than confirming the scoop.

“I did a commercial for Kraft [Heinz],” Reid said. “I have to be careful with that. I’ll keep that in my thigh.”

His answer sent the press conference room into laughter. Reid then playfully struck the podium with his right hand, seemingly bringing the questioning to an end without giving Torre the confirmation he wanted.

The comment referenced Reid's association with Kraft Heinz, including a 2026 campaign promoting Kraft Singles around National Cheeseburger Day. The promotion gave fans opportunities to claim free cheese slices and enter competitions involving Super Bowl LXI tickets and a potential lifetime supply.

However, there was another important development. Torre and Chang sent a prepared batch to Reid , who appeared impressed after tasting it.

“That’s awesome. You’re right on!” he responded, seemingly giving the recreation his approval.

articles.title: The real reason Travis Kelce was cropped out of Prince William’s selfie
articles.standfirst: Kelce breaks his silence after William confessed he tried to remove him from the picture
articles.summary: Kelce breaks his silence after William confessed he tried to remove him from the picture
articles.body:
Travis Kelce has explained why he understands Prince William's attempt to keep him out of a now-famous photograph with Taylor Swift, admitting that the royal had a perfectly reasonable explanation for his actions.

The Kansas City Chiefs tight end discussed the revelation on New Heights, the podcast he hosts alongside his older brother, Jason Kelce . The conversation comes after William's recent appearance on The Graham Norton Show, where he shared details about their unexpected encounter.

The photograph was taken backstage at Wembley Stadium in June 2024, after William attended Swift's Eras Tour concert with his eldest children, Prince George and Princess Charlotte.

The group posed with the singer, and Kelce joined them for a selfie that would eventually attract considerable attention.

Swift later shared the image on Instagram to wish William a happy 42nd birthday. The post also marked the first time she had publicly shared a photograph of herself with Kelce , effectively confirming their relationship on social media.

William recently admitted that he hadn't understood the significance of the photograph when it was taken. Speaking to Norton , he jokingly revealed that he'd actually been trying to move Kelce out of the frame, only for the football player to keep returning.

“I wasn't until recently,” William said. “I hadn't appreciated the significance, and actually – I was trying to move him out of the photo!

“Travis kept coming back in, and I couldn't work out why he kept coming back in.”

Travis Kelce explains why Prince William wanted him removed

Kelce addressed the prince's confession, making it clear that he wasn't offended by the situation.

The NFL star explained that he understood William's perspective because he was still Swift's boyfriend at the time, rather than her husband.

“I was the boyfriend of my now-wife, and he didn't necessarily want me in the photos with his daughter, or at least at the time he was like, maybe we just get photos with Taylor, just us,” said Travis .

“I completely understood that because then you didn't know if there was a forever there yet.

“You don't know, and you don't want the picture to be ruined for eternity if it doesn't work out. So I get it, I get it.”

Jason agreed with his brother, describing William's reasoning as completely understandable. The conversation became even funnier when Jason suggested that the podcast's graphics team should digitally remove Travis from the original selfie.

The team later made an edited version without the Chiefs player. Kelce appeared delighted with the result and joked about sending the updated photograph directly to Buckingham Palace, wondering whether it would actually reach the prince.

His response suggested there were no hard feelings between the two men. Their relationship has also developed considerably since their first meeting in London.

William later made a surprise appearance on New Heights in July 2026, joining the Kelce brothers for a prerecorded conversation that aired on the same day Swift and Kelce married at Madison Square Garden in New York.

The couple began dating in 2023 and announced their engagement in August 2025, turning the once-uncertain romance into a marriage.

articles.title: Travis Kelce’s special shoutout to Taylor Swift on his 100th home game
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs star celebrates a special career achievement while looking back on the stadium where his love story with Swift began
articles.summary: The Chiefs star celebrates a special career achievement while looking back on the stadium where his love story with Swift began
articles.body:
Travis Kelce marked a major milestone in his Kansas City Chiefs career with a moment filled with memories both on and off the football field.

The star tight end appeared in his 100th regular-season home game at Arrowhead Stadium this past Sunday, when the Chiefs delivered a commanding 34-7 victory over the Arizona Cardinals. Reflecting on the achievement during the November 25 episode of his New Heights podcast, Travis also made a heartfelt reference to his wife, Taylor Swift.

Speaking with his older brother and podcast co-host, Jason Kelce, Travis discussed what the historic stadium has meant to him throughout his 14 seasons with the Chiefs.

“Hundred games, dude, it feels pretty awesome right now,” Travis said. “To think about the legacy of that stadium, man, and it’s pretty crazy to think they’re moving on from that stadium, because of all the history that’s happened over the years and history of the franchise and everything.

“You know it’s been home for me for 14 years, and it’s been one of my favorite places to go to play and to watch not only football, but musical events, and I’ve had so much history and so many things that mean so much to me happen at Arrowhead that a hundred games, it’s pretty awesome to hit that milestone,” he said.

Among those memories was Swift's record-breaking Eras Tour performance at Arrowhead in July 2023. Travis attended the concert before their romance became public, famously revealing that he had attempted to give the singer a friendship bracelet featuring his phone number.

That moment eventually became part of the story behind their relationship, which has since attracted enormous attention from fans around the world.

A milestone filled with personal memories

Swift was also present for Travis ' latest achievement, watching the Chiefs' victory from a stadium suite alongside her parents, Scott and Andrea Swift , and members of the Kelce family. Travis scored twice during the game, while his performance helped Kansas City secure an impressive win.

The occasion also added another chapter to his already remarkable career. Travis became only the fourth player in Chiefs history to reach 100 regular-season home appearances at Arrowhead. Travis also moved past Rob Gronkowski in career touchdowns, further strengthening his standing among the NFL's most productive tight ends.

However, the stadium's future means the milestone carries additional significance. Kansas City has announced plans to construct a new $3 billion enclosed-roof stadium in Wyandotte County, Kansas. The facility is expected to open ahead of the 2031 NFL season, bringing an end to the Chiefs' long association with their current home.

Travis acknowledged that leaving Arrowhead would be emotional, considering everything he has experienced there.

The podcast discussion also raised questions about his playing future. After jokingly offering a toast to another 100 games, Travis admitted that reaching such a number again might be unrealistic.

Jason questioned whether his younger brother was confirming another season with Kansas City, but Travis insisted he hadn't made any announcement.

“No, I’m not confirming it. I’m not confirming it,” Travis stated.

As for the Chiefs, they now turn their attention to a Thanksgiving night showdown against the Buffalo Bills.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes takes on Brittany’s reflex test as their kids cheer him on
articles.standfirst: Sterling, Bronze and Golden jump and laugh as Patrick takes his turn in Brittany’s reflex test
articles.summary: Sterling, Bronze and Golden jump and laugh as Patrick takes his turn in Brittany’s reflex test
articles.body:
B rittany Mahomes shares a family video of her “reflex test,” with Patrick, Sterling, Bronze and Golden taking part. Each lies face down with a clear dish over their face as water pours in from above. The first splash gets a jump out of everyone, but the children’s biggest reaction comes when it is their dad’s turn.

Patrick lies down beside them, ready to take the same splash they have already faced. Sterling, Bronze and Golden crowd around him, bouncing with excitement as they wait to see his reaction. They laugh and jump alongside their dad, fully caught up in the game.

A family moment worth more than a perfect reaction

The test itself is simple. What makes the video memorable is how eagerly the kids join in when Patrick takes his turn. He is not just watching them play; he gets down on the floor and becomes part of the fun.

A family can have every material comfort, but those shared memories come from something money cannot buy: time, patience and the willingness to be present. Brittany and Patrick give their children a moment to laugh, play and enjoy one another.

A 2024 study in the Journal of Happiness Studies found that children recall shared play with their parents among their happy moments, underscoring how simple activities together can strengthen family bonds and support children’s emotional well-being.

For Sterling, Bronze and Golden, their dad is the quarterback they watch from a VIP suite at Arrowhead Stadium, throwing passes and leading the Chiefs’ offense. Now they get to see him try the same challenge they just did this time in their living room and laugh at how he looks and reacts when the water hits.

That dad, Patrick, knows what’s best for his kids.

articles.title: Will Taylor Swift be at the Chiefs vs Bills game? What we know about her attendance for the Thanksgiving game
articles.standfirst: Kansas City head to the Highmark Stadium to face Buffalo and Josh Allen
articles.summary: Kansas City head to the Highmark Stadium to face Buffalo and Josh Allen
articles.body:
Taylor Swift ’s presence at the Kansas City Chiefs ’ visit to face the Buffalo Bills remains uncertain, with no confirmation that she will travel to Highmark Stadium to support husband Travis Kelce ahead of one of the NFL ’s biggest games of the season on Thanksgiving . The billionaire popstar has been a familiar face at home games at the Arrowhead Stadium , but her road appearances have been far less frequent due to reported security concerns - and that remains central to Thursday’s speculation ahead of Week 12.

The Chiefs are leaving the Arrowhead Stadium behind in Missouri for their latest clash and Swift ’s recent attendance record offers little reason to assume she will be in Buffalo . That is despite owning property in New York City meaning it is one of the less inconvenient road visits she could pick across the full NFL schedule. The 37-year-old has attended all of the Chiefs home games this season, including the recent victory over the Arizona Cardinals on November 22, but she was not seen at the road game just prior against the Denver Broncos – despite it being a huge game in the AFC West . In fact, Swift has not been photographed at an away game since 2024 as she continues to maintain a preference for attending football games in Missouri instead.

Why Swift may not travel to Buffalo for Thanksgiving

Security has been cited in coverage as a possible factor behind Swift ’s preference for home fixtures although neither her nor Kelce have publicly confirmed that this is the reason for her attendance pattern as both are famous for keeping their private life close to their chests. That privacy means supporters may not receive an answer before kickoff whilst the game could also bring another high-profile figure into the stands. Hailee Steinfeld , who is married to the Bills ’ Josh Allen , and has been linked to the matchup because of her connection to the home team. But there has been no confirmed joint appearance or announcement about either woman’s plans as Buffalo enters the Thanksgiving contest with a 9-1 record, while Kansas City is 8-2, and the game marks the 11th meeting between Allen and Patrick Mahomes . Their rivalry has included four postseason matchups, all won by Mahomes , and now the pair will be doing battle once again in a matchup that could have massive ramifications in the AFC West and across the wider AFC conference as the NFL Playoffs slowly draw closer. The Chiefs and Bills meet at Highmark Stadium on Thursday, November 26, with kickoff scheduled for 20:20 ET/17:20 PT on NBC and Peacock, with pregame coverage beginning at 20:00 ET.

articles.title: Kansas City Chiefs vs Buffalo Bills: Where to watch Patrick Mahomes vs Josh Allen and what time is the Thanksgiving Day game
articles.standfirst: Bills vs. Chiefs at Highmark Stadium: the Week 12 showdown worth a seat at the top of the AFC.
articles.summary: Bills vs. Chiefs at Highmark Stadium: the Week 12 showdown worth a seat at the top of the AFC.
articles.body:
The rivalry that has defined the latest era of the American Conference is heating up once again. In Week 12 of the 2026-2027 NFL season , the Buffalo Bills host the Kansas City Chiefs at Highmark Stadium , a showdown between two of the hottest teams in the league that could completely reshape the race for the AFC lead .

The Thanksgiving landscape: two trains launched

Rarely does this classic arrive with both teams so sharp. Buffalo leads the AFC East with a record of 9 wins and 1 loss , the best record in the entire conference and second overall in the NFL, behind only the San Francisco 49ers (9-1) on point differential. The Bills have scored 313 points and allowed 208 , for a +105 differential that speaks of a dominant team on both sides of the ball.

Kansas City , meanwhile, comes in with 8 wins and 2 losses , a mark that puts them in second place in the AFC West —just behind the Denver Broncos (8-2) on tiebreakers— and sixth in the league standings overall.

The most fearsome thing about the Chiefs is their defense : with just 163 points allowed , they are the team that has conceded the fewest points in the entire AFC. Their +108 differential is, in fact, slightly higher than that of the Bills themselves.

In summary: the conference's most explosive offense against the stingiest defense . That's the chess match that will be played in Buffalo.

The marquee showdown: Josh Allen vs. Patrick Mahomes, once again

It doesn't take much to sell this game. In the middle of the field will be the two field generals who have defined the league's last decade: Josh Allen , 30 years old and wearing number 17 for the Bills, against Patrick Mahomes , 31 years old and wearing number 15 for the Chiefs.

Whenever these two meet, the clock and the scoreboard usually become the main characters until the very last breath.

Allen has at his disposal a revamped arsenal of weapons. At receiver, DJ Moore (number 2), Khalil Shakir (number 10), and young Keon Coleman (number 0) stand out, while tight end Dalton Kincaid (number 86) provides a constant threat over the middle.

In the backfield, James Cook III (number 4) anchors the running game that gives Buffalo's offense so much relief and that will be key to controlling the clock against a Kansas City defense that punishes mistakes.

On the other side, Mahomes relies on an offensive group that combines veteran experience and speed. The ageless Travis Kelce (number 87) , at 37 years old, remains the trusted tight end in decisive moments, while Rashee Rice (number 4) and the speedy Xavier Worthy (number 1) give the offense a vertical threat.

In the running game, Kenneth Walker III (number 9) is the piece Kansas City needs to avoid becoming one-dimensional against the Bills' defense.

Where to watch the Kansas City vs Buffalo game LIVE and what time does it start?

The opening whistle for the game between Chiefs and Bills is scheduled for this Thursday, November 26, 2026 , at 5:20 p.m. Eastern Time (4:20 p.m. Central Time and 2:20 p.m. Pacific Time), with national broadcast coverage in the United States on NBC .

The Buffalo Bills vs. Kansas City Chiefs in Week 12 will be played at Highmark Stadium , in the city of Buffalo, a venue with a capacity of 71,608 fans .

Implications in the battle for the top of the NFL

The weight of this game goes far beyond pride. The Bills are defending the AFC lead , and a win would leave them with a 10-1 record, strengthening their path toward home-field advantage in the conference playoffs .

For Kansas City , winning at Highmark Stadium would mean tying Buffalo in number of losses (both would have two) and putting themselves squarely in the conversation for the top seed , in addition to taking the head-to-head tiebreaker away from the Bills—a detail that in January can be worth its weight in gold.

In the AFC West , the Chiefs are also dealing with a parallel battle: they are chasing the Broncos , who share their 8-2 record. Every win counts double when the division is this tight, and a positive result in Buffalo would be a huge statement of intent heading into the final stretch of the season.

Chiefs vs Bills: Prediction

This matchup has all the ingredients to be decided by the slimmest of margins. The home-field advantage , the better combined offensive-defensive record, and the momentum of a 9-1 record tip the scales slightly toward the Bills , but the most solid defense in the AFC and Mahomes' stature in big games guarantee that Kansas City will not go down without fighting until the very end.

Prediction: narrow Buffalo victory , in a game that will very likely be decided on the final possession.

articles.title: Jason Kelce denies Travis's toast to “100 more games” at Arrowhead and puts his brother on the spot about retirement
articles.standfirst: Kelce has shrugged off retirement for two seasons in a row, and doesn’t rule out doing it once again
articles.summary: Kelce has shrugged off retirement for two seasons in a row, and doesn’t rule out doing it once again
articles.body:
T ravis Kelce has given Kansas City Chiefs fans another reason to wonder whether his NFL career will continue beyond this season as after celebrating his 100th regular-season game at Arrowhead Stadium , the tight end was challenged by brother Jason over a toast that sounded more ambitious than his retirement outlook. The exchange came on the November 25 episode of New Heights , as the brothers looked back on Kansas City 's 34-7 victory over the Arizona Cardinals four days earlier, a milestone marked in front of his family who watched from the stands as he scored twice, including Taylor Swift .

Kelce had raised a glass after the game and toasted “100 more” at Arrowhead , a line Jason was quick to question as he joked, “You said cheers to 100 more after the game. You're not gonna play f***ing 100 more games. What are you talking about?” Travis accepted the obvious point but did not exactly close the door on an extended career as he replied with acceptance, but also doubled down, “Yeah, you're right, I won't. But cheers to 100 more! Who knows how many I'll get to?” Jason seized on the comment and asked whether his younger brother was confirming he would return for another season, but the Chiefs star refused to give him the answer supporters may have wanted, leaving his future unresolved.

Jason Kelce presses his brother over a possible Chiefs return

The milestone itself came during a standout afternoon against Arizona as Kelce caught six passes for 74 yards to add to his two scores in the 34-7 win as the Chiefs moved to 8-2 in the 2026 NFL season as he described Arrowhead as home after 14 years with Kansas City . His production gives Kansas City a compelling reason to want him back as through 10 games this season, Kelce has recorded 41 receptions for 586 yards and four touchdowns, leading the Chiefs in receiving yards, and his performance against the Cardinals was a timely reminder of his continued influence in the passing game. And his form is key with Kansas City preparing for a Thanksgiving trip to face the Buffalo Bills as the Chiefs enter the matchup at the Highmark Stadium against a 9-1 team, in a contest with major implications for the AFC picture and another chapter in the Patrick Mahomes - Josh Allen rivalry. Kelce 's role could be important against a Buffalo defense dealing with injury concerns as cornerback Christian Benford and linebacker Dorian Williams were listed as questionable in the Bills ' final injury report, opening the door for the tight end to take advantage.

articles.title: Travis Kelce braves Buffalo’s brutal temperatures as fans worry about his health
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs tight end ignored the cold and rain during warmups, choosing a summer-style outfit while everyone around him bundled up
articles.summary: The Chiefs tight end ignored the cold and rain during warmups, choosing a summer-style outfit while everyone around him bundled up
articles.body:
T ravis Kelce's commitment to the Kansas City Chiefs is unquestionabl e, and changing weather conditions rarely seem to affect the way players approach game day. However, t he tight end caught fans' attention ahead of Thursday night's matchup against the Buffalo Bills after showing up on the field dressed very differently from everyone else.

Rain was expected throughout the game, meaning Kelce knew what conditions awaited him at Highmark Stadium. Still, he stepped onto the field wearing nothing more than a beanie, a T-shirt and shorts. Meanwhile, most of the players and staff around him had opted for long pants, hoodies and additional layers to protect themselves from the cold.

Fans are hoping Kelce stays healthy

The unusual outfit quickly raised concerns among NFL fans, who were worried that the Chiefs star could end up getting sick . The last thing Kansas City needs is for Kelce to catch a cold, especially with an important game on the schedule.

A potential illness would be particularly unfortunate given the team's recent progress . Kansas City appears to be finding its momentum again after going through a difficult stretch, with Kelce and Patrick Mahomes continuing to lead the team.

A challenging night awaits both teams in Buffalo

Both teams will have to deal with cold rain and strong wind gusts on Thursday night as the Chiefs and Bills renew their rivalry at Highmark Stadium on Thanksgiving Day. The weather conditions add another challenge to a matchup that already carries plenty of weight.

The game also marks the 11th showdown between Patrick Mahomes and Josh Allen. The two quarterbacks are tied at five wins apiece through their first 10 meetings, although their records tell different stories depending on the competition. Allen holds a 5-1 advantage in regular-season games, while Mahomes has won all four of their playoff encounters.

articles.summary: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s first Thanksgiving as a married couple did not go as planned.

articles.summary: Brittany Mahomes exploded on social media after the Chiefs’ controversial loss to the Bills.
articles.body:
The biggest players are expected to deliver when the pressure is at its highest, but that was not the case for Travis Kelce , who had a chance to change the outcome of the Kansas City Chiefs’ Thanksgiving showdown against the Buffalo Bills .

In one of the most anticipated matchups of the NFL season, the Chiefs and Bills battled in a dramatic contest that went down to the final moments. Kansas City fought until the end, but a 57-yard game-winning field goal from Tyler Bass sealed the team’s second loss of the season.

However, many believe the outcome could have been different if one key play had gone another way — a crucial late drive that involved Kelce.

Travis Kelce misses a game-changing catch

Before Bass’ kick decided the game, Kelce had an opportunity to extend the drive and give Kansas City a chance to force overtime, but the star tight end was unable to complete the catch.

The play was also tied to a controversial officiating decision involving Rashee Rice , as officials ruled that the pass was incomplete after the ball made contact with the ground.

From there, everything changed. The Bills escaped with the victory, while the Chiefs were left wondering what could have been.

Brittany Mahomes also shared her frustration on Instagram Stories, reacting to the controversial call.

“HAHAHAHAHA WHAT A JOKE. Guess we can’t even play football without getting it called against us… not sure what an actual [penalty] is after that, I guess? I don’t wanna hear [expletive] anymore from anyone,” she wrote.

articles.title: Andy Reid challenges the referees after Rashee Rice's catch against the Bills was overturned
articles.standfirst: Andy Reid didn’t hold back after the Chiefs’ Thanksgiving loss to the Bills, blasting the controversial call that overturned Rashee Rice’s catch.
articles.summary: Andy Reid didn’t hold back after the Chiefs’ Thanksgiving loss to the Bills, blasting the controversial call that overturned Rashee Rice’s catch.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs suffered a painful 13-10 loss to the Buffalo Bills in the highly anticipated Thanksgiving showdown, but a controversial officiating decision became one of the biggest storylines of the night.

Kansas City had multiple opportunities to change the outcome of the game. Despite their own mistakes and several plays that put them in difficult situations, the Chiefs entered the fourth quarter with two possessions to either take the lead or force overtime .

However, one crucial play became the center of controversy and left head coach Andy Reid frustrated.

Andy Reid questions overturned Rashee Rice catch

Facing a third-and-10 from their own 9-yard line, Patrick Mahomes connected with Rashee Rice on a pass over the middle that was initially ruled complete and appeared to give the Chiefs a fresh set of downs.

The play seemed to provide new life for Kansas City’s offense, but after video review, officials overturned the ruling and determined the pass was incomplete.

The decision sparked a strong reaction from fans and analysts, quickly becoming one of the most debated moments of the game. After the loss, Reid made it clear he disagreed with the ruling.

“Not one that I agree with,” Reid said of the overturned call. “They said it came from New York. It wasn’t from our guys (the referees), they called it a completion. I’m not quite sure what they saw. I saw he had control of the ball, then his elbow hit, then the ball hit, but he had control. Normally in those situations, it has to be clear and obvious. To me, that was not clear and obvious.”

NFL once again under scrutiny over catch rule

After Rice’s catch was overturned, the Chiefs were forced to punt. Kansas City’s defense managed to get the ball back to the offense with another opportunity, but the team failed to capitalize.

The Bills responded with a final drive and secured the victory with a game-winning field goal as time expired .

Had Rice’s catch stood, Kansas City would have had a new possession with 1:41 remaining on the clock . No one can know what would have happened from there, but the Chiefs would have had a chance to control the clock and potentially make a game-winning play or force overtime.

The NFL has faced criticism for years over its inability to establish a clearer definition of what qualifies as a catch, with rulings that have often created confusion and controversy.

With the loss, the Chiefs dropped to 8-3 on the season , while the Bills improved to 10-1 and took control of the AFC .

articles.title: Travis Kelce gets emotional reminiscing about first time he saw Taylor Swift during Chiefs game at Arrowhead in 2023
articles.standfirst: After celebrating his 100th regular-season home game, the tight end opened up about the unforgettable memories made at the Chiefs stadium
articles.summary: After celebrating his 100th regular-season home game, the tight end opened up about the unforgettable memories made at the Chiefs stadium
articles.body:
When Travis Kelce looks back on his time at Arrowhead Stadium , the memories that stand out are not restricted to touchdowns, playoff victories or championship celebrations. The Kansas City Chiefs tight end also associates the venue with a pivotal evening in July 2023, when he watched Taylor Swift perform before the pair embarked on their relationship.

Those memories resurfaced after Kelce made his 100th regular-season home appearance during Kansas City's 34-7 victory over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday, prompting a sentimental conversation with his brother Jason on Wednesday's episode of New Heights.

Having spent 14 seasons with the Chiefs , Kelce admitted that the franchise's plans to eventually leave Arrowhead were difficult to comprehend given everything he had experienced inside the stadium.

"To think about the legacy of that stadium, man, and it's pretty crazy to think they're moving on from that stadium, because of all the history that's happened over the years and history of the franchise and everything," Kelce said.

The tight end also reflected on his appreciation of Arrowhead as an entertainment venue, a particularly significant observation considering how his relationship with Swift first developed.

Stadium where Taylor Swift love story began

Long before Swift became a familiar presence at Chiefs games, Kelce attended one of her Eras Tour concerts at Arrowhead in July 2023, hoping to introduce himself to the singer.

He subsequently revealed on New Heights that he had prepared a friendship bracelet featuring his phone number but had been unable to deliver it. That unsuccessful gesture nevertheless became one of the defining anecdotes surrounding the beginning of their romance.

"You know it's been home for me for 14 years, and it's been one of my favorite places to go to play and to watch not only football, but musical events, and I've had so much history and so many things that mean so much to me happen at Arrowhead that a hundred games, it's pretty awesome to hit that milestone," Kelce said.

Three years after that concert, Swift was back at Arrowhead on Sunday alongside her parents, Andrea and Scott, watching her husband celebrate another significant achievement in his NFL career.

Kelce's emotional Arrowhead admission

The milestone also arrives at an intriguing stage of Kelce 's career, with the 37-year-old yet to announce whether he will continue playing beyond the 2026 NFL season.

"Cheers to 100 more," Kelce said, prompting Jason to press him about his professional future, although the Chiefs star stopped short of making any commitment.

Kansas City's anticipated departure from Arrowhead following the 2030 season adds another layer of significance to Kelce 's remaining appearances at the venue, regardless of when he ultimately decides to retire.

Having married Swift in July, Kelce has reached a point in his life where Arrowhead represents considerably more than his professional accomplishments. It's also the place where an unsuccessful attempt to meet one of the world's biggest music stars became the opening chapter of their love story.

articles.summary: A playful effect transformed Clark and Tavia Hunt’s walk to their suite into a holiday dance
articles.body:
Gracie Hunt gave her family a Thanksgiving entrance with a twist. As her parents, Kansas City Chiefs chairman and CEO Clark Hunt and Tavia Hunt, walked through Highmark Stadium toward their suite before the game, Gracie recorded them with an effect that made their hips appear to sway in time with the music.

Gracie Hunt found the perfect soundtrack for a playful moment with her parents. She filmed them with a TikTok effect that made their hips sway to A Charlie Brown Thanksgiving – Holiday Music & Sounds. Her caption summed it up: “Getting my serious family dancing on Thanksgiving.”

The Hunts’ Thanksgiving dance came before a tough finish for Kansas City

The loss made for a disappointing end to Thanksgiving night for the Hunt family, who were there to support the team. Still, at 8–3, the Chiefs remain in the playoff picture.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes’ Instagram Stories suggest the Bills got more than one break after the Rashee Rice call
articles.standfirst: Her Instagram Stories went beyond one disputed catch
articles.summary: Her Instagram Stories went beyond one disputed catch
articles.body:
Brittany Mahomes’ reaction to the Chiefs’ Thanksgiving loss grew into more than one angry post. After Kansas City fell 13–10 to Buffalo, she shared a series of Instagram Stories that built a case for why, in her view, the Chiefs had been treated unfairly. She opened with “WHAT A JOKE,” questioning the call that overturned Rashee Rice’s apparent catch.

With the game tied 10–10 and less than two minutes left, Patrick Mahomes connected with Rice for an apparent 11-yard gain on third-and-10. The play was first ruled a catch, but the NFL replay center reversed the call and ruled it incomplete. The league’s vice president of instant replay later said Rice lost control when his hand slid up the ball as he hit the ground.

Her stories questioned more than the catch

Brittany reshared clips and posts from fans and commentators who argued the ball should have counted as a catch. One called it “highway robbery”; another labeled it one of the worst calls of all time.

She also shared a First Take graphic featuring analyst Mike Tannenbaum saying he was “1,000%” sure Rice had made the catch. The sequence made her position clear: she believed the replay reversal was wrong.

Then her Stories widened the argument to the game clock . She reposted a graphic asking whether the clock operator had given Buffalo extra time, alongside a fan’s claim that the clock moved from 26 seconds to 25 after Mahomes fumbled the snap and the Bills called timeout.

CBS Sports later examined the sequence: the clock had reached 19 seconds before six seconds were restored to 25 for the next play. That raised questions about the clock management, but the sequence alone does not establish that anyone deliberately helped Buffalo.

Another repost showed referee Alex Kemp warming himself near a heater on the Bills’ sideline, with Buffalo players nearby. Its caption suggested the scene would have become front-page news if the referee had been on Kansas City’s sideline.

The posts suggested she felt the Chiefs had been on the wrong end of several moments that night . She never directly accused the NFL of favoring Buffalo, but her message came through: from her point of view, the calls didn’t feel fair to Kansas City.

Chiefs coach Andy Reid also questioned the catch reversal, saying he thought Rice had control and that the evidence was not clear and obvious enough to overturn the call. The NFL’s replay official defended the decision.

Kansas City’s drive ended in a punt, and the Bills eventually won when Tyler Bass made a 57-yard field goal as time expired. The loss left the Chiefs at 8–3; Brittany’s Stories captured the frustration of a close game in which fans had more than one officiating question to argue about.

articles.body:
Harrison Butker's struggles from the kicking spot have become an increasingly difficult problem for the Kansas City Chiefs , and Thursday night's defeat against the Buffalo Bills has brought fresh questions about his future with the franchise.

Kansas City suffered a heartbreaking 13-10 loss in Buffalo after Butker missed a crucial 46-yard field goal in the fourth quarter. With the score tied at 10, the veteran had an opportunity to put the Chiefs ahead, but his attempt sailed wide right, leaving the door open for the Bills to take control.

Head coach Andy Reid was asked whether he remained committed to Butker following another costly mistake. However, the longtime Chiefs coach avoided making any immediate promises about the kicker's position.

"Yeah, I'll go back and go through all of it again here, but not going to make any decisions right this minute," Reid said.

The response leaves Butker's future uncertain as Kansas City enters a critical stretch of its 2026 campaign. His latest miss was his eighth field goal failure of the season, making his inconsistency an increasingly difficult issue for the coaching staff to ignore.

Justin Tucker's presence adds pressure on Butker

Butker's latest setback comes despite some encouraging performances in recent weeks. He had converted field goals from 40 and 44 yards against Arizona, suggesting he was beginning to regain his rhythm. However, the miss against Buffalo renewed concerns about his consistency, particularly when the pressure is highest.

The Chiefs have another option available in Justin Tucker , who joined Kansas City's practice squad as insurance. His presence gives Reid an alternative if the coaching staff decides a change is necessary. Veteran Matt Prater has also received a tryout, adding another potential option to the conversation.

articles.title: “Lazy with his head”: Travis Kelce is slammed for the costly mistake that sealed the Chiefs’ loss to Buffalo
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs star came under fire from the NFL legend after a crucial late-game miscue helped Buffalo snatch a dramatic victory
articles.summary: The Chiefs star came under fire from the NFL legend after a crucial late-game miscue helped Buffalo snatch a dramatic victory
articles.body:
Travis Kelce has come under fire following the Kansas City Chiefs' disappointing 13-10 Thanksgiving defeat against the Buffalo Bills, with NFL Hall of Famer Shannon Sharpe blaming the tight end for a costly mistake during the closing seconds.

Speaking on Nightcap, the show he co-hosts with Chad “Ochocinco” Johnson, Sharpe questioned Kelce's concentration after he failed to turn his head in time to catch a pass during Kansas City's final possession.

The Chiefs started their last drive from their own 11-yard line with just 26 seconds remaining and the score tied at 10-10. Kelce had successfully created separation from his defender, but his delayed reaction meant Patrick Mahomes' throw fell incomplete.

Sharpe was particularly unimpressed with the tight end's failure to recognize the opportunity, suggesting the play could've changed the outcome of the game.

“You see how lazy he was with his head? He swam over the guy, the guy dropped him, he's wide open. All he has to do is get his head around,” Sharpe said.

“Who knows, he can get out of bounds, we know that for sure. Guy might miss a tackle, you might take it to the house. He got lazy.”

Shannon Sharpe questions Kelce's awareness in difficult conditions

Sharpe's frustration wasn't limited to the missed reception. He also highlighted the challenging weather conditions at Highmark Stadium, arguing that Kelce should've been more alert during such a critical moment.

“In a situation like this where the elements are, you've got to have your antenna up, the spidey senses, because it's raining, it's cold. Now all of a sudden you stop the clock,” said Sharpe .

The Chiefs failed to secure another first down and were forced to punt three plays later. Buffalo appeared to get a hand on Matt Araiza's kick, allowing Greg Dortch to return the ball 17 yards to Kansas City's 39-yard line.

Tyler Bass then delivered the decisive blow, converting a dramatic 57-yard field goal as the clock expired.

The victory improved Buffalo's record to 10-1, while Kansas City slipped to 8-3, adding another disappointing chapter to the Chiefs' Thanksgiving outing.

Away from the action on the field, Kelce's wife, Taylor Swift , also attracted attention after missing the matchup. Her absence wasn't particularly surprising, however, as the singer has generally avoided attending the Chiefs' regular-season away games over the past two seasons.

Swift's decision is reportedly linked to security arrangements and travel logistics. She regularly attends Kansas City's home fixtures at Arrowhead Stadium, where dedicated security measures are already established.

She was recently spotted supporting Kelce during the Chiefs' victory over the Arizona Cardinals, when the tight end scored twice.

The couple married at Manhattan's Madison Square Garden on July 3, 2026, wearing custom Dior outfits designed by Jonathan Anderson. Swift's brother Austin served as her man of honor, while Kelce's brother Jason took on the role of best man.

Although Thanksgiving didn't go according to plan on the football field, the couple will have an opportunity to celebrate Christmas together, with Kansas City having no game scheduled on Christmas Day.
